title: ¿Qué dejó el siglo XX?
goal: Read a closing synthesis of the unit's four themes -- paths of change, the double-edged use of constitutions, unresolved inequality, and shared memory -- as the region entered the new millennium.

items: Describe the complex inheritance the region carried into 2000.
Explain what the Bolivia/Costa Rica comparison demonstrated.
Explain how constitutional reform proved to be a double-edged tool.
State what still remained unresolved as the region entered the new millennium.
Use en resumidas cuentas to introduce a summarizing conclusion.
